policy: Verified positive and negative news feeds a bounded, time-decaying simulation overlay; base assumptions remain owner-controlled.

items.headline: O: lawsuit seeks halt on new AI models
items.summary: Advocacy groups filed to freeze new model development/deployment, naming O alongside multiple AI labs. Potential impact is uncertainty around future releases and regulatory/operational constraints.

items.headline: O: developers changelog adds Agent SDK capabilities
items.summary: O’s API changelog notes Agent sandboxes now include the Artifact SDK and tools for creating/editing spreadsheets, presentations, and Word documents. This supports broader agent workflows and faster product iteration.

items.headline: G: seeks ~$8B valuation in new round
items.summary: Bloomberg reports G is seeking funding at about an $8B valuation, with a plan to expand revenue and ramp economics over coming years. Implies fresh capital access and valuation support amid AI selloff.

items.headline: V: $251M Series D to scale space pharma processing
items.summary: V announced a $251M Series D to scale space-based pharmaceutical processing, stating total capital raised of $598M. Signals capacity scaling and increased ability to serve future in-orbit manufacturing demand.
